EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS


Claimant:







Respondent:
Mr D Castro


v

(1) Ms M Rangel







(2) Cubana (Waterloo) Limited




Heard at: London (South) (via CVP)


On: 15 December 2025

Before: Employment Judge Fredericks-Bowyer

Appearances
For the claimant:
In Person
For the respondent: Mr P Oppenheim


JUDGMENT AT PUBLIC PRELIMINARY
HEARING

1. The harassment claim against the 1st respondent is dismissed because it was
brought out of time and it is not just and equitable for the Tribunal to hear the
complaint; it is beyond the jurisdiction of the Tribunal.

2. The unfair dismissal claim against the 2nd respondent is struck out because, given
his admissions about his conduct leading to dismissal in this hearing, it has no
reasonable prospect of success.

3. The five day hearing listed to be heard for from 19 April 2027 is consequentially
vacated.



Employment Judge Fredericks-Bowyer

Dated: 15 December 2025


Case Number: 6013952/2024

2 of 2














NOTES:

1.
Oral judgment was given at the hearing. Written reasons will not be provided unless requested at the hearing or a
request is made in writing by a party within 14 days of the sending of this document.

2.
Where written reasons are produced, they will be published in their entirety on the public Employment Tribunal
decisions website here: Employment tribunal decisions - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)."}]}
